_comment: Copy to .env.secrets.json (gitignored by the .env* rule). `npm run setup:check` validates it and tests the Slack, Notion, model (Anthropic or OpenRouter) and Turso credentials; `npm run setup:env` loads every value below into the linked Vercel project as a Production environment variable. Nothing in this file is ever printed by the scripts. Never paste any of it into chat.

vercel.scope: <optional: Vercel team slug, only if the project lives in a team>

secrets.TURSO_DATABASE_URL: <libsql://… from `turso db show uncle-sam --url`, or from the Turso integration in the Vercel Marketplace>
secrets.CRON_SECRET: <random string of 32+ characters; Vercel Cron sends it as Authorization: Bearer … to /api/cron/tick>
secrets.UNCLE_SAM_QA_ASKERS: <optional: Slack user IDs allowed to @-mention questions, comma-separated, e.g. U0F9EF97D89,U0CB213D6D6; leave empty to let every full workspace member ask>
secrets.SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET: <Slack app A09DDB3817C → Basic Information → Signing Secret>
secrets.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN: <xoxb-… from OAuth & Permissions after installing to workspace T07011B7862>
secrets.NOTION_TOKEN: <ntn_… internal integration token; share Uncle Sam Operations and the Recruiting database with it>
secrets.NOTION_WEBHOOK_SECRET: <verification token Notion sends when the webhook subscription is created; leave empty until then>
secrets.PORTAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET: <shared secret the take-home portal sends in x-uncle-sam-secret; leave empty until Interviewer wires it>
secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: <sk-ant-… key from console.anthropic.com for the Company workspace>
secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY: <optional alternative to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: an sk-or-v1-… key from openrouter.ai. Anthropic's own key wins when both are set>
secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: <optional: full service-account JSON as one string; enables calendar-driven feedback prompts>
secrets.UNCLE_SAM_CALENDAR_SOURCE: <optional: notion = read ended interviews from the clerk's Uncle Sam Operations log; unset = Google Calendar>
secrets.GOOGLE_IMPERSONATE_SUBJECT: <optional: a Workspace user to impersonate with domain-wide delegation, e.g. project@company.example>
secrets.UNCLE_SAM_CALENDAR_FLOOR: <optional: leave empty until cutover; then the time this bot takes over calendar prompts, with its zone, e.g. 2026-10-15T14:20:00Z>
secrets.WISPR_TOKEN_KEY: <optional: 32 random bytes, base64 (openssl rand -base64 32); turns on the Wispr Flow connection and encrypts its tokens>
secrets.UNCLE_SAM_OUTBOX_CHANNEL: <optional: the private channel #uncle-sam-outbox (C…); Project's scheduled tasks post there and Uncle Sam re-posts each message into his DM as itself>
secrets.UNCLE_SAM_ONBOARDING: <optional: off stops the work-trial account requests to Jamie and AA (service/lib/onboarding.mjs); leave empty to keep them on>
secrets.UNCLE_SAM_OKTA_WITH_JAMIE: <optional: on asks AA for Okta at the same time as Jamie for the Company email and Slack; leave empty to ask AA only once Jamie's part is done>
secrets.UNCLE_SAM_MANUAL_REJECTS: <optional: off stops the rejection that follows a take-home or deep dive set to Reject by hand on the Take-homes tab>
secrets.UNCLE_SAM_ACCOUNT_CREATION: <optional: on lets Uncle Sam create work-trial hires' Company Google accounts itself (needs Project's admin role and re-grant, the Slack join link and the approved template); leave empty to keep asking Jamie>
secrets.UNCLE_SAM_SLACK_JOIN_URL: <optional: https sign-up link for Company's Slack for @company.example addresses, sent with the new account; needs Slack's approved-domain sign-up on>
secrets.UNCLE_SAM_BOOKING_LOOKUP: <optional: off stops Uncle Sam answering 'when is this scheduled for' from the team's calendars>
secrets.UNCLE_SAM_DECISION_NUDGES: <optional: off stops the overdue-decision asks to interviewers>
secrets.UNCLE_SAM_NEW_BOOKINGS: <optional: off stops adding people who booked a call and aren't on the tracker>
secrets.UNCLE_SAM_WATCHDOG: <optional: off stops the alerts about lost Google or Slack access, failing runs and gaps>
secrets.CLAY_API_KEY: <optional: a Clay API key (Clay > API and CLI > API keys); turns on pipelines from Clay>
secrets.CLAY_ENRICH_PERSON_ROUTINE: <optional: the Clay Enrich Person function id; default function:t_0tl2hpydaph4xhA64aF>
secrets.CLAY_DAILY_MAX: <optional: most Clay lookups a day; default 40>
secrets.UNCLE_SAM_RECAPS: <optional: off stops reading interview recaps in #int-recruitment onto the tracker>
secrets.DOCUSIGN_INTEGRATION_KEY: <optional: the Uncle Sam app's integration key (DocuSign Apps and Keys), for resends>
secrets.DOCUSIGN_ACCOUNT_ID: <optional: the DocuSign account to act in; default Company AI>
secrets.DOCUSIGN_ENV: <optional: demo to use DocuSign's developer environment; default production>
secrets.DOCUSIGN_PACKET_TEMPLATE_ID: <optional: the DocuSign template for the standard work-trial packet; default Jamie's Work Trial template>
secrets.DOCUSIGN_COMPANY_SIGNER_NAME: <optional: who countersigns the packet for Company after the candidate; default Project Owner>
secrets.UNCLE_SAM_PACKET_ADDENDUM: <optional: on adds the per-person compensation addendum (pay per day) as the 4th packet document>
secrets.UNCLE_SAM_PAPERWORK_FOLLOWUP: <optional: off stops the DocuSign reminder and countersignature follow-up>
secrets.UNCLE_SAM_KEEP_WARM: <optional: off stops the once-a-minute warm-up of the button endpoint>
secrets.UNCLE_SAM_FAST_FOLLOWUPS: <optional: off stops the every-minute interview follow-up check (the 5-minute tick still asks)>
secrets.UNCLE_SAM_MEET: <optional: off stops reading interviewers' Google Meet records>
secrets.UNCLE_SAM_MEET_PEOPLE: <optional: who gets a Google Meet connect link, comma names (interviewer, robin, alexis, project); default interviewer>
secrets.STRIPE_API_KEY: <optional: a Stripe RESTRICTED key (rk_live_), read-only on Connect accounts and transfers; turns on trial pay from Stripe>
secrets.STRIPE_ONBOARDING_KEY: <optional: a Stripe RESTRICTED key (rk_live_) with Write on Connect accounts only (no transfers, no payouts); turns on the mid-trial payout setup email>
secrets.UNCLE_SAM_PAYOUT_SETUP: <optional: off stops the mid-trial payout setup email>
secrets.UNCLE_SAM_STRIPE: <optional: off stops reading trial pay from Stripe>
